newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's property shares up on price recovery hopes.
newsitem.headline: Japan's property shares up on price recovery hopes.

text.p: Shares in the real estate 0#REA.T sector rose across the board on Monday, supported by hopes for a recovery in land prices, traders said.
The sector was the second largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
By 0147 GMT, shares in Tokyu Land Corp had risen 23 yen to 452, Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd 30 yen to 1,500 and Tokyo Tatemono Co Ltd 16 yen to 637.
Hopes of a recovery in the real estate market were fuelled by a comment by National Land Agency Minister Kosuke Ito on Friday that Japan's land prices have almost stabilised after sustained falls.
He said it was the first time that land prices have shown signs of stabilising since the bursting of the "bubble economy" of inflated asset prices in the early 1990s.
Some traders also said the rise in property shares was due to recent buying in domestic demand-related shares, while the stronger yen slowed buying in exporters.
